about.heading: Home-style vegetarian food, served for your biggest days
body: Olive started in 2023 with a simple idea: vegetarian food that tastes like home, presented the way a special day deserves.

Since then we have catered more than 500 events across Gandhidham and nearby towns, including 30+ large weddings. Our chefs cook traditional recipes with modern presentation, and our trained hospitality staff and supervisors look after every counter and every guest.

image.alt: Chef plating a vegetarian thali with dal, sabzi and rotis

faq.q: Is all your food pure vegetarian? Do you make Jain food?
faq.a: Yes. Everything we cook is pure vegetarian, and we prepare Jain menus without onion, garlic or root vegetables for any event.

faq.q: Which areas do you cater in?
faq.a: We cater across Gandhidham and Adipur and travel to nearby towns in Kutch, including Anjar, Bhuj, Mundra and Kandla.

faq.q: What kind of events do you cater?
faq.a: Weddings, NRI and destination weddings, corporate events, birthdays and social gatherings, festival and religious functions, and daily canteen service for schools, colleges and industrial units.

faq.q: How far in advance should we book?
